title: Add ability to set color, size and font of system monitor widget
line: The System Monitor widget's Text Only style can now use a custom font (family, style and size) and a custom text color.
explanation: The System Monitor widget's text comes from its display style, and the Text Only style, the one that is all text, always drew its labels and values with the system font and the color scheme's text color, with no option to change them. The face's options page only had the grouping checkbox. The Text Only Details page now has Font (System font / Custom with a Choose Style… font dialog, like the Digital Clock) and Text color (Custom with a color button). On the desktop the chosen font and size are used for all sensor rows and the font family for the title, and the legend's width cap now grows with the font so big text doesn't get squeezed into elided columns; in a panel the family, style and color apply while the size keeps following the panel thickness.

commits.message:
faces/textonly: add font and text color options

The Text Only display style always used the system font and text color,
so there was no way to make its text bigger or to give it a different
font or color. Add a custom font and a custom text color to its options.

BUG: 499572

patches.diff:
From 88bd81f035b3d752f34933ce19d8deba59b7f554 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:49:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces/textonly: add font and text color options

The Text Only display style always used the system font and text color,
so there was no way to make its text bigger or to give it a different
font or color. Add a custom font and a custom text color to its options.

BUG: 499572
---
 .../textonly/contents/config/main.xml         | 10 ++
 .../contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml     | 17 +++-
 .../textonly/contents/ui/Config.qml           | 96 ++++++++++++++++++-
 .../contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml        |  7 ++
 .../textonly/contents/ui/GroupedText.qml      | 12 ++-
 5 files changed, 138 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/config/main.xml b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/config/main.xml
index fcc686aa..cb5f54f1 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -9,5 +9,15 @@
         <entry name="groupByTotal" type="Bool">
             <default>false</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="useCustomFont" type="Bool">
+            <default>false</default>
+        </entry>
+        <entry name="customFont" type="Font">
+        </entry>
+        <entry name="useCustomTextColor" type="Bool">
+            <default>false</default>
+        </entry>
+        <entry name="customTextColor" type="Color">
+        </entry>
     </group>
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 7810fb86..cdb647f5 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -41,11 +41,24 @@ Faces.CompactSensorFace {
     readonly property bool useSmallFont: (horizontalFormFactor && height < defaultMetrics.lineSpacing + 2) || (verticalFormFactor && width < defaultMetrics.averageCharacterWidth * 6 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)
     readonly property real lineHeight: useSmallFont ? smallMetrics.lineSpacing : defaultMetrics.lineSpacing
 
+    readonly property font textFont: {
+        const baseFont = useSmallFont ? Kirigami.Theme.smallFont : Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont
+        if (!controller.faceConfiguration.useCustomFont) {
+            return baseFont
+        }
+        let customFont = Qt.font(controller.faceConfiguration.customFont)
+        customFont.pointSize = baseFont.pointSize
+        return customFont
+    }
+
     clip: true
 
     contentItem: GridLayout {
         id: layout
 
+        Kirigami.Theme.textColor: root.controller.faceConfiguration.useCustomTextColor ? root.controller.faceConfiguration.customTextColor : undefined
+        Kirigami.Theme.inherit: !root.controller.faceConfiguration.useCustomTextColor
+
         columnSpacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
         rowSpacing: 1
 
@@ -83,9 +96,9 @@ Faces.CompactSensorFace {
                 value: sensor.formattedValue
                 color: lowPriority ? "transparent" : root.colorSource.map[modelData]
 
-                font: root.useSmallFont ? Kirigami.Theme.smallFont : Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont
+                font: root.textFont
 
-                maximumValueWidth: Formatter.Formatter.maximumLength(sensor.unit, root.useSmallFont ? Kirigami.Theme.smallFont : Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont)
+                maximumValueWidth: Formatter.Formatter.maximumLength(sensor.unit, root.textFont)
 
                 ToolTip.visible: false
 
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/Config.qml b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/Config.qml
index 07b1d993..2546276f 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/Config.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/Config.qml
@@ -7,8 +7,10 @@
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 import QtQuick.Controls as Controls
+import Qt.labs.platform as Platform
 
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kquickcontrols
 
 import org.kde.ksysguard.sensors as Sensors
 import org.kde.ksysguard.faces as Faces
@@ -17,11 +19,103 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     id: root
 
     property alias cfg_groupByTotal: groupCheckbox.checked
+    property alias cfg_useCustomFont: customFontRadioButton.checked
+    property font cfg_customFont
+    property alias cfg_useCustomTextColor: customTextColorCheckbox.checked
+    property color cfg_customTextColor
 
     Controls.CheckBox {
         id: groupCheckbox
         Layout.fillWidth: true
         text: i18nc("@option:check", "Group sensors based on the value of the total sensors.")
     }
-}
 
+    Item {
+        Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
+    }
+
+    Controls.ButtonGroup {
+        buttons: [defaultFontRadioButton, customFontRadioButton]
+    }
+
+    Controls.RadioButton {
+        id: defaultFontRadioButton
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:group", "Font:")
+        text: i18nc("@option:radio", "System font")
+        checked: !root.cfg_useCustomFont
+    }
+
+    RowLayout {
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        Controls.RadioButton {
+            id: customFontRadioButton
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio", "Custom:")
+            onClicked: {
+                if (root.cfg_customFont.family === "") {
+                    root.cfg_customFont = Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        Controls.Button {
+            text: i18nc("@action:button", "Choose Style…")
+            icon.name: "settings-configure"
+            enabled: customFontRadioButton.checked
+            onClicked: {
+                fontDialog.currentFont = root.cfg_customFont
+                fontDialog.open()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    Controls.Label {
+        visible: customFontRadioButton.checked
+        Layout.leftMargin: customFontRadioButton.indicator.width + customFontRadioButton.spacing
+        text: i18nc("@info %1 is the font size, %2 is the font family", "%1pt %2", root.cfg_customFont.pointSize, root.cfg_customFont.family)
+        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        font: root.cfg_customFont
+    }
+
+    Controls.Label {
+        visible: customFontRadioButton.checked
+        Layout.leftMargin: customFontRadioButton.indicator.width + customFontRadioButton.spacing
+        text: i18nc("@info", "In a panel, the text size follows the panel's thickness.")
+        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
+    }
+
+    RowLayout {
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label", "Text color:")
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        Controls.CheckBox {
+            id: customTextColorCheckbox
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Custom:")
+            onClicked: {
+                if (checked && !root.cfg_customTextColor.valid) {
+                    root.cfg_customTextColor = Kirigami.Theme.textColor
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        ColorButton {
+            id: textColorButton
+            enabled: customTextColorCheckbox.checked
+            showAlphaChannel: false
+            color: root.cfg_customTextColor
+            onAccepted: color => root.cfg_customTextColor = color
+        }
+    }
+
+    Platform.FontDialog {
+        id: fontDialog
+        title: i18nc("@title:window", "Choose a Font")
+        modality: Qt.WindowModal
+        parentWindow: root.Window.window
+
+        onAccepted: {
+            root.cfg_customFont = font
+        }
+    }
+}
